fields.description: JSON map: channel -> SAP AR customer code. E.g. {"AMAZON": "C001"}
fields.label: Channel Customer Map

fields.description: JSON map: channel -> SAP bill-to address code. E.g. {"AMAZON": "BT001"}
fields.label: Bill-To Code Map

fields.description: JSON map: channel -> SAP ship-to address code. E.g. {"AMAZON": "ST001"}
fields.label: Ship-To Code Map

fields.description: JSON map: tax key (e.g. "18_intra") -> SAP tax code string
fields.label: Tax Code Map

fields.description: JSON map: channel -> true/false (whether UC prices are tax-inclusive)
fields.label: Tax Inclusive Map

fields.description: JSON map: UC warehouse code -> SAP warehouse code
fields.label: Warehouse Map

fields.description: JSON map: channel -> SAP warehouse code (per-channel override over warehouse_map)
fields.label: Channel Warehouse Map

fields.description: JSON map: channel -> destination state (2-letter, e.g. KA) -> intra|inter -> {product, shipping} G/L account codes. intra = same state (CGST+SGST), inter = IGST. Use top-level "default" for channel or state fallback. Example: {"FLIPKART":{"KA":{"intra":{"product":"41101","shipping":"41102"},"inter":{"product":"41103","shipping":"41102"}},"default":{"intra":{"product":"41100","shipping":"41102"},"inter":{"product":"41100","shipping":"41102"}}}}
fields.label: G/L Account Map (channel, state, intra/inter)

fields.description: JSON map: UC itemSku -> {item_code, qty_multiplier}, for UC catalog SKUs that are broken duplicates of a real bundle (registered as SIMPLE in UC instead of BUNDLE, so bundleSkuCode never appears on their order lines). Rewrites the line to N x the real component before invoicing/batch-checks. E.g. {"FGHN0056": {"item_code": "FGHN0054", "qty_multiplier": 3}}
fields.label: SKU Alias Map (broken bundle duplicates)

fields.description: JSON map: channel -> last fetched timestamp (ISO format). Managed automatically by the fetch worker.
fields.label: Last Fetched At JSON

fields.description: Default GST origin state code for tax classification (e.g. KA for Karnataka). Used when channel has no override.
fields.label: Default Origin State Code

fields.description: Fallback SAP warehouse code when no channel or UC warehouse mapping is found.
fields.label: Default Warehouse Code

fields.description: JSON map: channel -> origin state code (2-letter). Overrides built-in defaults and Default Origin State Code. Built-in: AMAZON_FBA_IN_MAA4/CJB1 -> TN; DEL4/DEL5 -> HR; BOM5/BOM7 -> MH; all other channels use Default Origin State Code (e.g. KA). Example: {"FLIPKART": "KA", "AMAZON_FBA_IN_BOM5": "MH"}
fields.label: Channel Origin State Map

fields.description: JSON map: UC channel code -> SAP SeriesN bucket used for GST reconciliation. Keys are the **channel** codes that appear in UC sale orders (e.g. FLIPKART, MEESHO, CRED, AMAZON_IN_API, AMAZON_FBA_IN_BLR7, AMAZON_FBA_IN_BOM5, HN_SITE_IN, DOGSEE_SITE_IN, SNAPDEAL, ...). Values are the SAP SeriesN that every invoice for that channel should roll up to (KAB2C26 / MHB2C26 / HRB2C26 / TNB2C26). Used only by the GST Reconciliation flow on the Ops Center.
fields.label: Channel to SAP Series Map (GST Recon)

fields.description: Comma-separated SAP SeriesN values to include in the GST Reconciliation SAP pivot (defaults to the FY26 B2C series).
fields.label: GST Reconciliation SAP Series

fields.description: JSON map: channel -> SAP AR Invoice series number. Takes priority over ar_invoice_series.
fields.label: AR Invoice Series Map

fields.description: Default SAP series number for AR Invoices (used when no channel-specific series is mapped).
fields.label: AR Invoice Series

fields.description: SAP series number for Credit Notes.
fields.label: Credit Note Series

fields.description: Number of times to retry a failed invoice or credit note post before marking it dead.
fields.label: Max Retry Attempts

fields.description: Minutes to wait before treating a 'posting' order as timed out and moving it to verify queue.
fields.label: Posting Timeout (Mins)

fields.description: Suppress duplicate alerts for the same record within this many minutes.
fields.label: Alert Debounce (minutes)

fields.description: Only send a reconciliation alert once the gap count exceeds this threshold.
fields.label: Reconciliation Gap Threshold
EC-FG FEFO Fallback on Batch Shortage
fields.description: When enabled, orders whose UC-specified batch has insufficient stock in EC-FG will automatically use FEFO-allocated batches instead of going to batch_hold. Disable to require exact batch availability.
